contracts: dll.c owns driver-side DLL image load entries
A DLL_ENTRY owns exactly one optional mapped view one optional section handle one optional file handle and its pool allocation
Failure after any partial acquisition releases the acquired view section handle file handle and pool allocation before returning NULL
Successful entries remain owned by Dll_List until Dll_Unload removes and releases them
Driver-private handles opened by this loader use OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE combined with OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE
runtime_gate: Windows driver build plus a loader failure-injection smoke that exercises failure after file open, after section creation, and after view mapping, proving no handle/view/pool leak under Driver Verifier or equivalent pool/handle tracking. A normal driver init/unload smoke must prove successful DLL entries still support syscall/export discovery and are freed at unload.
